compliance.mnpiPolicy: Guidepoint says advisors must affirm before each project that they will not disclose confidential or material non-public information; project managers screen requests and involve Legal and Compliance as needed.
compliance.expertVetting: Guidepoint describes third-party background checks for new advisors, annual checks on a rolling sample of active experts, annual compliance tutorials, and client-specific screening.
compliance.coolingOffPeriod: Advisor terms prohibit consulting about a current employer; former finance or accounting employees must wait four months before consulting about that employer.

overview: Guidepoint connects clients with expert advisors and provides surveys, healthcare data intelligence through Qsight, a transcript library, and live events. As of November 2026, the company reports 5,000+ client organizations, 2M+ advisors, 2,000+ employees, 20 global offices, and 130,000+ library transcripts. Founder Albert Sebag serves as CEO. Guidepoint360 brings expert access, transcripts, and AskGP synthesis into one platform. During 2026, Guidepoint announced a mobile app, MCP integrations with Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini Enterprise for Financial Services, and a repositioning toward AI-powered access to expert insights.

history.narrative: Guidepoint was founded in 2003 by Albert Sebag. A 2020 Boston College Law School profile describes his doctorate in organic chemistry at Northeastern University, legal education at Boston College, and work as a patent litigator at Kenyon and Kenyon. Sebag described an earlier cancer clinical-trial database venture and a pivot toward research for financial firms. Guidepoint acquired Vista Research from Standard & Poor's in 2009 and Innosquared in 2015. Integrity Research reported that Guidepoint absorbed Quanton Data in 2016; Qsight followed in 2018. The company launched Guidepoint360 and AskGP in October 2025 and expanded its mobile and AI integrations during 2026.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Calls
servicesDetailed.description: Guidepoint's core offering: one-on-one consultations with advisors from its company-stated 2M+ network. Dedicated project teams support sourcing and screening; the company describes AI-assisted matching, client approval of experts, and project-level compliance controls.

servicesDetailed.name: Surveys
servicesDetailed.description: Expert-sourced surveys for quantitative market research. Guidepoint offers questionnaire design, recruitment, programming, and data delivery, as well as program-and-host, recruiting-only, and quick-poll formats. The company lists adoption trends, pricing dynamics, and competitive shifts among research uses.

servicesDetailed.name: Guidepoint Library / Insights
servicesDetailed.description: A library of searchable transcripts and audio recordings from expert interviews. Guidepoint reports 130,000+ transcripts as of November 2026. Clients can filter by company, industry, geography, date, or format and use AskGP to synthesize content with links to source passages. Guidepoint Insights produces moderated research content for the library.

servicesDetailed.name: Guidepoint Qsight
servicesDetailed.description: Healthcare data intelligence for Medical Aesthetics and MedTech investors and executives. Qsight combines transaction data, market models, and primary research for sales intelligence, market monitoring, and practitioner insights. Recent company announcements include Social Intelligence (November 2025), the Cross-Purchasing Dashboard (May 2026), and Consumer Tracker (November 2026).

servicesDetailed.name: AI Moderation
servicesDetailed.description: Announced October 22, 2025, AI Moderation enables expert interviews without a client attending live. Guidepoint says it supports dozens of simultaneous interviews, structured prompts, and 24/7 availability. At launch, the company reported thousands of early-adopter interviews and use of the same interviewer for AI-Guided library transcripts. Findings can be synthesized with AskGP.

servicesDetailed.name: Guidepoint360 / AskGP
servicesDetailed.description: Launched in October 2025, Guidepoint360 is a unified platform merging AI and expert knowledge. AskGP is its conversational AI research assistant that synthesizes insights across eligible Guidepoint Library content and client call transcripts, with source citations. A mobile app was announced on February 11, 2026.

servicesDetailed.name: Events
servicesDetailed.description: Guidepoint hosts live teleconferences, roundtables, and conferences. Its March 26, 2026 announcement reported 1,400+ hosted teleconferences per month; its current corporate-services page also cites 1,400+ monthly live teleconferences. These complement one-on-one expert calls and on-demand transcripts.

aiPlatform.narrative: Guidepoint360, launched with AskGP in October 2025, brings expert consultations, transcripts, AI tools, and project organization into a single platform. Guidepoint describes AskGP as a conversational interface for searching and synthesizing content that a client is entitled to access, with links to source passages. AI Moderation supports interviews without live client attendance. The company announced its mobile app in February 2026 and MCP connections with Claude, Perplexity Computer for Finance, and Gemini Enterprise for Financial Services during 2026.

complianceExtended.narrative: Guidepoint describes three compliance stages: Advisor Eligibility, Project Compliance, and Project Review. Its published controls include employer opt-outs, advisor tutorials, project screens, and client monitoring. These are company descriptions of the program, not an independent assessment of its effectiveness. Catherine Smith is listed as Chief Legal Officer; the company's FY2024 statement describes her as a former SEC enforcement attorney.
highlights: Company-described framework: Advisor Eligibility, Project Compliance, Project Review
Guidepoint says new advisors receive background checks and active experts are re-checked on an annual rolling sample
Company says its Employer Database Registry blocks participation where an employer prohibits it
Advisor tutorial required on joining and every twelve months, according to Guidepoint
Advisor terms permit a request for full-project payment when an engagement is ended early to comply with those terms
Company describes downloadable consultation records and a complete audit trail
Guidepoint says AskGP prompts and responses are not used to train or fine-tune its models or third-party foundation models

clientFit.narrative: Guidepoint markets its services to institutional investors, consulting firms, corporations, and professional services firms. It reports 5,000+ client organizations overall. Its FY2024 statement says its client list included nine of the top ten consulting firms and more than 500 hedge funds at that time; these are company-stated figures. Qsight is aimed at healthcare investors and Medical Aesthetics and MedTech businesses.
